local readings = {
    { tag = "café", value = 42 },
    { tag = 'quiet', value = nil },
}

--[=[ This comment contains ]] and
still belongs to the same comment. ]=]
local function describe(reading)
    local note = [==[
a multiline label
including a shorter ]=] delimiter
]==]
    if reading.value ~= nil then
        return ("%s: %02d"):format(reading.tag, reading.value)
    end
    return note .. "\n" .. reading.tag
end

for index, item in ipairs(readings) do
    print(index, describe(item))
end
